text:
Noah Patel: Hey all, first-day question from me — I got the 'complete security onboarding' email but also a note about a hardware token for MFA. Do new hires get a YubiKey automatically or only if you request one? Also curious about phishing sims frequency and what triggers the micro-training.

Zoe Park: Welcome Noah! Default is software MFA (Okta Verify) for everyone. YubiKeys are available on request for people who need hardware second factors (SREs, infra, execs) or who prefer it. File a ticket to request one and IT will ship it. Phish sims run quarterly and the micro-training is triggered only if you click the simulated bad link / enter creds.

Ricardo Silva: Quick add: if you request a YubiKey, we register it to your Okta account and mark it as a backup. You should still set up Okta Verify as primary until the key is provisioned. Also make sure your laptop is enrolled in MDM and has disk encryption enabled before enabling VPN.

onboarding-bot: Reminder: "Security Basics" assigned to @Noah Patel, due 14 days (1950001234). YubiKey requests handled by IT ticketing.

Noah Patel: Thanks. I'm using a personal laptop temporarily while waiting for the company Mac. Is there a short checklist I should run through so I don't accidentally sync work secrets to personal accounts? I have Docker and a few git credentials saved.

Zoe Park: Do not store work secrets in personal Keychain or cloud storage. Short checklist: 1) Enroll in MDM if you have an approved exception, 2) enable FileVault/BitLocker, 3) remove any personal cloud sync for dotfiles that contain creds (eg. disable rsync/Dropbox for ~/.ssh), 4) install company browser profile and block external password managers for work sites. If you're not getting an exception, stop and wait for the company laptop.

Ricardo Silva: For local containers consider using a secrets manager (we use Vault for internal stuff) or pass env vars via a build tool instead of storing them in plain files. If you need to migrate creds off your personal device, IT can help scrub them.

IT Support: To request a YubiKey or a personal-device exception, open ticket with subject: "YubiKey/request" or "Personal device exception: <name>". For quick checks: macOS: `sudo fdesetup status` ; Windows PS: `Get-BitLockerVolume`. We'll validate MDM enrollment on receipt.

Noah Patel: I'll wait for the company machine and follow up if I need a key. One last thing — are phishing sim failures visible to managers? I'm curious about privacy.

Zoe Park: No — audits are used for compliance and to auto-assign the micro-course. Managers don't get a fail notification by default unless there's a pattern of repeated fails that needs coaching. The program is designed for remediation, not punishment.

Noah Patel: Great, appreciate the clarity. Also added: can someone add me to #sec-updates and confirm which training link to use?

onboarding-bot: Added to #sec-updates. Security Basics link: https://learn.redwood/sec-basics.

Noah Patel: Thanks everyone :smile:
